term: nonempty cycle in the necessary-support union
definition: There exists a necessary individual b such that Relation.TransGen of the union relation restricted to the necessary subtype holds from b back to b. TransGen requires at least one edge, unlike reflexive-transitive reachability. This permits loops or longer closed walks and does not require a simple cycle. A separate component may contain a source.
note: Source-free finite graph investigation #604. No metaphysical actuality, divine identity, uniqueness, or root discharge is asserted.
